definitions.explanation: An introductory section at the beginning of a book or document, typically written by the author to explain the purpose, scope, or background of the work.

examples.japanese: {前書|まえが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前書|まえが}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The author wrote this book's preface.

examples.japanese: {前書|まえが}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The preface describes the purpose and background of this research.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (before, front) + ⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (writing). Refers specifically to the introductory text that precedes the main content of a book or document.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前書|まえが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write a preface)
- {前書|まえが}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧ (to state in the preface)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{序文|じょぶん}→序文：06205_jobun⟧: a more formal term for a preface or introduction, often used for academic or literary works
- {後書|あとが}き: afterword — the concluding remarks at the end of a book
